Judge Halts Trump Golf Course Tree Removal After Hundreds Cut

A judge has halted further tree removal at the East Potomac golf course in Washington D.C. after 430 to 500 trees were cut down over a weekend. The judge expressed outrage and fury over the demolition of the trees, which were part of a project associated with the Trump administration.
